We first need to decompose the integrand into its quotient and remainder parts, which we can do using synthetic division.

We draw up a synthetic division table:

$$
\begin{aligned} & {x}^{3} & {x}^{2} & {x}^{1} & {x}^{0} \\ -1 & 2 & -3 & 0 & 2 \\  & ↓ & -2 & 5 & -5 \\  & 2 & -5 & 5 & -3\end{aligned}
$$

So from the synthetic division, we get that

$$
\frac{2{x}^{3}-3{x}^{2}+2}{x+1}=2{x}^{2}-5x+5-\frac{3}{x+1}.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}\frac{2{x}^{3}-3{x}^{2}+2}{x+1}\,\text{d}x & ={\int }_{0}^{2}(2{x}^{2}-5x+5-\frac{3}{x+1})\text{d}x \\  & =2{\int }_{0}^{2}{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x-5{\int }_{0}^{2}x\,\text{d}x+5{\int }_{0}^{2}\text{d}x-3{\int }_{0}^{2}\frac{1}{x+1}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{2}{3}{x}^{3}\,{|}_{0}^{2}-\frac{5}{2}{x}^{2}\,{|}_{0}^{2}+5x\,{|}_{0}^{2}-3\operatorname{ln}⁡|x+1|\,{|}_{0}^{2} \\  & =\frac{2}{3}({2}^{3}-{0}^{3})-\frac{5}{2}({2}^{2}-{0}^{2})+5(2-0)-3(\operatorname{ln}⁡|2+1|-\operatorname{ln}⁡|0+1|) \\  & =\frac{16}{3}-10+10-3\operatorname{ln}⁡3 \\  & =\frac{16}{3}-3\operatorname{ln}⁡3.\end{aligned}
$$
